author: Driftlet
description_zh: 屿族纸卡：CPU / GPU / 内存三环占比 + 系统整体占用热力图，一瞥全览
description_en: Isles paper card: CPU / GPU / memory rings plus an overall-load heatmap, everything at a glance

settings.description_zh: 屿族栅格两档——切换即调整窗口到对应尺寸
settings.description_en: Two Isles grid tiers — switching resizes the window

settings.description_zh: 最外环显示哪项；与其他环重复时自动对调位置
settings.description_en: Metric on the outermost ring; duplicates swap places automatically

settings.description_zh: 中间环显示哪项；与其他环重复时自动对调位置
settings.description_en: Metric on the middle ring; duplicates swap places automatically

settings.description_zh: 最内环显示哪项；与其他环重复时自动对调位置
settings.description_en: Metric on the inner ring; duplicates swap places automatically

settings.description_zh: 多个 GPU（核显/独显）时按型号名选择本机 GPU（绑定 LUID，枚举顺序变化不影响）；「自动」= 独显优先（无独显取枚举首项）
settings.description_en: Pick a GPU by model name when several exist (bound by LUID, immune to enumeration order); Auto = discrete GPU first (first enumerated when none)

settings.description_zh: 整体占用均值中 CPU 的占比权重（0–10）
settings.description_en: CPU's weight in the overall mean (0–10)

settings.description_zh: 整体占用均值中 GPU 的占比权重（0–10）
settings.description_en: GPU's weight in the overall mean (0–10)

settings.description_zh: 整体占用均值中内存的占比权重（0–10）
settings.description_en: Memory's weight in the overall mean (0–10)

settings.description_zh: 热力图一格汇总多少秒（取窗口内均值，5–120）
settings.description_en: How many seconds one heatmap cell aggregates (window mean, 5–120)

settings.description_zh: 一键应用整套配色（会覆盖下方五个颜色项）
settings.description_en: Apply a whole color scheme at once (overrides the five color settings below)

settings.description_zh: 横条档环与指标的左右排布（小方档上下对称不受影响）
settings.description_en: Ring/metrics left-right arrangement in the wide tier (the mini tier is symmetric)

settings.description_zh: 卡面背景色；透明度滑杆让卡面半透明；零值格轨道色自动按背景明暗派生
settings.description_en: Card background; the opacity slider makes the card translucent; the zero-cell track tint derives from its lightness automatically

settings.description_zh: 最外环的弧色与对应数据条
settings.description_en: Arc of the outer ring and its metric bar

settings.description_zh: 中间环的弧色与对应数据条
settings.description_en: Arc of the middle ring and its metric bar

settings.description_zh: 最内环的弧色与对应数据条
settings.description_en: Arc of the inner ring and its metric bar

settings.description_zh: 热力图格子的五档加深基色（0 值格为前景淡轨道）
settings.description_en: Base color of the heatmap's five deepening levels (zero cells use a faint foreground track)
